mods.description: Add-on mod for Wathe: Murder Mystery, made for "The Harpy Express: Extended" modpack.

releases.notes:
### Added

- New configurable options:
    - **Amnesiac**
        - **Keeps the game going** (Default: Enabled)
          *When enabled, the game won't end while the Amnesiac is still alive, meaning the Amnesiac can still
          pick a role even after all Killers are dead.*
- New texture for the **Copy Position** creative item
- New inventory ability row pagination system
    - Instead of splitting player picker rows into multiple lines, rows now fold into multiple pages when there are
      more than 12 players, keeping them on a single line. This should fix rows going off-screen, notably the
      **Guesser** player picker row
- World protection support for some [WathExtras](https://modrinth.com/mod/wathextras) blocks and lights

### Changed

- **Breaking:** refactored the client mixins into a new structure
- **Breaking:** split `WatheExtendedClient` into `InstinctClient`, `ProneClient`, and dedicated client networking and rendering classes
- **Breaking:** split `WatheExtended` into dedicated config entries, server networking, world tick and `EffectCleaner` classes
- Changed the `/pronouns set <field>` command to allow selecting a target with `/pronouns set <field> [target]`,
  primarily made for testing and available to OP players only
- Abstracted custom slot texture replacements to use one shared grayscale texture, tinted with a color mask based on
  the current role's color
- Set an ordering on lobby items and creative utility items: the Guidebook is always given in the first slot, followed
  by the Teleport to Ready Area item. Creative items are now always given on the opposite side of the hotbar
- The **Morphling** ability row now stays visible when the ability is triggered; its buttons are grayed out and not
  interactable
- Repositioned the unified name renderer further down the center of the screen to prevent it from overlapping with
  Wathe crosshair elements
- Updated Gradle to `9.8.2`
- Updated `CHANGELOG.md`

### Removed

- Custom Minecraft asset textures, in favor of them being bundled within the modpack rather than the mod itself
- Unused references to unused creative items

### Fixed

- **Morphling** disguise username and pronouns (if any) compatibility with the new unified name renderer
- Lobby items (Guidebook, Teleport to Ready Area) and creative utility items being duplicated when picking them up
  with the cursor

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rezelyn/Wathe-Extended/compare/4.0.0-beta.2-h1.4...4.0.0-beta.3-h1.4

releases.notes:
### Added

- New configurable options:
    - **Dreamer**
        - **Imprint notification** (Default: Disabled)
          *Displays a message in the action bar whenever a player is imprinted by the Dreamer.*
    - **Arsonist**
        - **Doused notification** (Default: Enabled)
          *Displays a message in the action bar whenever a player is doused by the Arsonist.*
        - **Doused notification delay** (Default: 10s)
          *Sets how long to wait before the message is sent to the doused player.*
- New mood mechanics and options:
    - **Prevent sprinting while depressed** (Default: Enabled)
    - **Disable role abilities while depressed** after a configurable delay in seconds (Default: Enabled, 0s)
- New proning mechanic, allowing players to crawl on the ground with the <kbd>C</kbd> key, with a configurable
  keybind option to switch between **Hold** and **Toggle** modes (Default: Toggle)
- New unified player name renderer, replacing the separate Wathe and HarpyModLoader name overlays:
    - Spectators can see the current role, modifier (s), player name, pronouns, Killer Cohort label, and some
      role- and modifier-specific labels, all in one shared adaptive overlay
- New plushies (they're mostly my friends who are helping me on the mod :3)
- Restored the ability to change perspective (<kbd>F5</kbd>) when the game is not active
- Pressing the inventory key while spectating now opens the Guidebook screen
- Visual debugger showing every configured spawn position (Lobby, Ready Area, and Play Area)
- GitHub issue templates and contributor guidelines

### Changed

- **Breaking:** simplified the client and server config accessors and switched to pretty-printed JSON configuration
  files. Old config files and saved presets are no longer supported
- **Breaking:** refactored a large part of the project's codebase and packages to improve maintainability and
  readability, which may break other mods that depend on Wathe: Extended's code
- Improved optional add-on compatibility: mixins for optional add-ons are now skipped when the corresponding mod is
  absent, fixing related crashes (#100)
- World protection improvements:
    - Players can no longer break or place blocks inside the lobby, ready, and play area boundaries
    - Added Wathe's Privacy Glasses and the blocks from [Wathe Extra Items](https://modrinth.com/mod/watheextraitems)
      and [WathExtras](https://modrinth.com/mod/wathextras) to the list of protected blocks
- Changed and added some visual effects:
    - A vignette now darkens the screen edges of the **Introverted** when inside a crowd of players
    - A vignette now darkens the screen edges of depressed players, increasing in intensity over time while
      depressed and disappearing once the player is no longer depressed
    - Improved Last Stand vignette rendering and coloring
- Custom plushie sounds now use a randomized pitch when squashed (yes, even Ish's meow)
- Updated Chinese translation (@haiman233)
- Updated Stupid Express to `2026.10.1-h1.4`
    - [Stupid Express Changelog](https://modrinth.com/mod/stupid-express/version/2026.10.1-h1.4)
- Updated README.md
- Updated CHANGELOG.md
- Changed versioning format

### Removed

- Removed the mood HUD shaking animations when the **Introverted** was inside a crowd of players
- Reverted the mixin patches for Stupid Express stale imports and the **Lovers** modifier spectator crash

### Fixed

- Configured map effects not applying correctly at game start, and the default gamemode not being restored correctly
  after Secret Murder rounds and server restarts
- Secret Murder chance option not being synced with Wathe's world NBT setting; it now follows that setting
- Killer Cohort overlay appearing for roles that shouldn't see it (**Arsonist**, **Executioner**, **Jester**, etc.)
  (#99)
- **Licensed Villain** and **Dreamer** having access to Instinct
- **Licensed Villain** dropping their *Revolver* when shooting innocents

releases.notes:
### Added - Creative, OP-only items to help set up and test a map: - **Create RTP Slot** - Saves your current position and rotation as a new random teleportation slot, as long as you are standing inside the Ready Area - **Trigger RTP** - Teleports every player to the registered teleportation slots - Useful when players are slow to board the train - **Add Players** / **Remove Players** - Spawns and despawns fake players to test the game with (requires the [Carpet](https://modrinth.com/mod/carpet) mod) - New configurable options: - **Passive Income** - **Base Passive Income**
*Changes the amount of coins granted by the vanilla passive income.* - **Adjust Passive Income**
*When enabled, passive income scales with the distance to the nearest player (applies to non-Innocents only).* - **Max Passive Income Distance** (Default: 10)
*Distance in blocks from the nearest player at which the scaled passive income drops to zero.* - **Minimum Passive Income** (Default: 0)
*Lower bound applied to the scaled passive income, so distant players still earn something.* - **Morphling** - **Morph Psychosis**
*Insane players see morphed players as their real selves.* - **Bartender** - **Defense Vial Price** and **Defense Maximum Time** - **Trapper** - **Sees Names** and **Role Mine Price** - **Guesser** - **Can Use Instinct** - **Infected** - **Kill Time** and **Cough Chance** - **Recon** - **Sees Names** - **Executioner** - **Can Pick Up Gun** - New Guidebook entries: - **Infected** - **Introvert** - **Stealthy** ### Changed - Updated Noelle's Roles to `1.7.1-h1.3` - [Noelle's Roles Changelog](https://modrinth.com/mod/noelles-roles-tmm/version/1.7.1-h1.3) ### Fixed - Sitting or sleeping players not getting randomly teleported at game start (@ItsSyfe) - **Vulture** Guidebook entry wrongly claiming it has the Instinct and Athletic abilities **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rezelyn/Wathe-Extended/compare/3.5.132...3.6.132

releases.notes:
### Added - **Items** tab inside the Wathe: Extended configuration screen, letting you view and edit the prices and cooldowns of every usable item from Wathe and supported add-ons - `/pronouns clear ` command, allowing OP players to clear other players' pronouns (@Basinity) - **Teleport to Scenery** item for creative OP players, teleporting them to the Spectator Spawn Position upon use - Moquette block color variants - HUD elements for the **Arsonist**, now showing the number of doused players required before being able to ignite - New configurable options: - **Kill Increase Time**
*Changes the number of seconds added to the timer when a Killer gets a kill.* - **Jump Mode**
*Changes the behavior of the jump restriction mechanic: **Default**, **Lobby Only**, or **Everywhere**.* - **Item Prices & Cooldowns**
*Configurable prices and cooldowns for every shop item from Wathe and supported add-ons (see the "Items" tab in the configuration screen).* - **Role Abilities** - **Cancel Ability** for the **Phantom** and **Morphling**
*Allows them to cancel their ability at any time by pressing the ability key again, instead of waiting for the full duration to end.* - **Ability duration** for the **Phantom** and **Morphling** - **Ability cooldown** for the **Phantom** and **Morphling** - New optional mechanic: **Last Stand** - If enabled, this changes the behavior of any remote death mechanic (e.g. a correct **Guesser** guess, a **Voodoo** trigger on a Voodoo Doll, or **Lovers** heartbreak).
Instead of being killed immediately, the damned player is notified and has a short period of time before they actually die (Default: 30s) - New Guidebook entries: - **Awesome Binglus** - **The Insane Damned Paranoid Killer** - **Better Vigilante** - New roles: *(more information in-game)* - **Technician** ### Changed - Major rework of the configuration screen: - Role- and modifier-specific options are now grouped into their own groups within the "Roles" and "Modifiers" tabs, instead of being mixed together in the "Game" category - Several visual and readability improvements - Renamed some options and descriptions to make it clearer what they do - Using the inventory key while inside the Guidebook screen now closes it - Improved item tooltips: they now explain more clearly what an item does and how to use it, and show styled cooldowns where applicable - Gameplay balancing: - Roles: - **Hunter** - Can no longer buy the default Knife, Poison Vial, and Scorpion from the shop - **Kidnapper** - Can no longer buy the Crowbar from the shop - **Physician** - The Pill is now invisible in hand to other players - **Cleaner** - No longer receives bonus coins by default for using the Sulfuric Acid Barrel on dead bodies (configurable) - The bonus coin value for using the Sulfuric Acid Barrel on dead bodies is now configurable (Default: 50 coins) - **Awesome Binglus** - Now starts with 4 Notes - Gains 50 coins per completed task - Can buy Notes in the shop - Can stack up to 64 Notes - Can see Notes through walls using Instinct - **Morphling** - Can now cancel their ability at any time by pressing the ability key again, instead of waiting for the full duration to end - **Phantom** - Can now cancel their ability at any time by pressing the ability key again, instead of waiting for the full duration to end - Items: - **Grenade** - Is now put on cooldown after being thrown, preventing players from spamming it (Default: 1m30s) ### Removed ...
